summary: Busy kerb in front of townhouses, 11 m away; cars park here.

drivers.seclusion: Townhouse frontage 11 m behind the kerb; more homes across the road at 21 m and beyond.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb on a wide road with parking lanes on both sides; room is fine.
drivers.traffic: Wide, busy through road; cars parked along both kerbs.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but two no-parking signs apply at specified times.

flags: No parking signs, times not recorded
sun_shade: Mostly open; palms and trees on the north side give light morning shade.

best_section.where: North kerb of Finney Road in front of the townhouse row
